```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'AGENTS.md'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'docs/**'
      - 'AGENTS.md'

jobs:
  generate-context:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install just
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/casey/just/releases/download/v1.13.0/just-1.13.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | tar xz
          sudo mv just /usr/local/bin/

      - name: Install tree
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y tree

      - name: Generate Rust documentation
        run: cargo doc --no-deps --document-private-items

      - name: Extract TypeScript definitions
        run: |
          # Assuming a just target exists for extracting TS definitions
          just extract-ts-defs
          # If the target outputs to `ts-definitions/`, ensure it exists
          if [ ! -d ts-definitions ]; then
            echo "ts-definitions directory not found after extraction."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Code structure analysis
        run: |
          mkdir -p analysis
          tree -a -L 3 src > analysis/code_structure.txt

      - name: Configuration extraction
        run: |
          mkdir -p analysis
          echo "Cargo.toml:" > analysis/config.txt
          cat Cargo.toml >> analysis/config.txt
          echo -e "\npackage.json:" >> analysis/config.txt
          cat package.json >> analysis/config.txt

      - name: Test information
        run: |
          mkdir -p analysis
          echo "Rust test files:" > analysis/tests.txt
          find . -name '*_test.rs' -o -path 'tests/*' >> analysis/tests.txt
          echo -e "\nNode.js test files:" >> analysis/tests.txt
          find . -name '*.test.ts' -o -name '*.spec.ts' >> analysis/tests.txt

      - name: Validate AGENTS.md
        run: |
          REQUIRED_SECTIONS=("Project Overview" "Development Workflow" "Code Conventions" "Testing Strategy" "Common Patterns" "Performance Considerations" "Debugging")
          MISSING=()
          for section in "${REQUIRED_SECTIONS[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -q "## $section" AGENTS.md; then
              MISSING+=("$section")
            fi
          done
          if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Missing sections in AGENTS.md: ${MISSING[*]}"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Package AI context bundle
        run: |
          mkdir -p bundle
          cp -r target/doc bundle/docs
          cp -r analysis bundle/analysis
          cp -r src bundle/src
          cp AGENTS.md bundle/AGENTS.md
          tar -czf bundle.tar.gz bundle

      - name: Upload Rust docs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rust-docs
          path: target/doc

      - name: Upload TypeScript definitions
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ts-definitions
          path: ts-definitions

      - name: Upload AI context bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ai-context-bundle
          path: bundle.tar.gz
```
